description: Use this when the user wants wedding invitations, save the dates, thank-you cards, or other wedding paper. Searches the Zola paper shop by card type, color, motif, and finish (foil, letterpress, custom photo). Gives up to 6 matching designs, each with its page on zola.com. A search with no match gives the colors and motifs that exist. Do not use for invitation wording (use zola_search_wedding_advice).

colors.description: Colors, for example 'green' or 'dusty blue'. A search without a match gives the available colors

custom_photo.description: Only designs with the couple's photo

motifs.description: Motifs or styles, for example 'floral' or 'barn & country'. A search without a match gives the available motifs

name: zola_search_invitations

available_colors.description: Color values for the colors filter

available_motifs.description: Motif values for the motifs filter

card_type.description: The card type of the search

designs.description: The matching designs, in the zola.com shop order

designer.description: The designer or brand that collaborates with Zola

price_per_card.description: Lowest price of one item in US dollars: one card, or one napkin, sticker, sign, or table number for those card types

status.description: no_results when no design matches the filters

total.description: Number of designs that match on zola.com

title: Search Zola Invitations and Paper
